text:
I had a same-day dental crown done here after already having a root canal treatment at another dentist. The whole process was very smooth and well organized, and everything was completed within about five hours. The staff were professional and reassuring, and the treatment felt efficient without being rushed.
Most importantly, the result has been excellent—now, four months later, I’m still very satisfied and the crown feels natural and comfortable. Price-performance was outstanding as well. Thank you very much to the team!

Over is good. Staff are nice and polite.
Premium hospital upgrade from the former one - Paolo.
Payment via mobile app is very convenient.
Patient room is safe, passcode will be provided.
Like the way they sustain.

Relatively small hospital, but large enough for the regional hospital. The staff are friendly and helpful. The ladies at the entrance help pointing out on where to go and which service is best for me. I went there for annual health check, so everything was Relatively straightforward. I need to wait for an hour for the return to be out, so I was looking for the food count in the hospital. Unfortunately there is none. Luckily, I'm in the Ari area so there's are lots of options available in the area. The health check price came in at a little under thb1,000 (basic health check), this was a surprise for me.

text:
This is an excellent hospital. We’ve been going here for decades. (Why all the low reviews?)
I agree some of the outpatient doctors are a bit iffy and they really need to update the cashier-area, but all the specialists (bone, skin, internal, eye, immunization, etc) are excellent.
Patient ward 19th floor. Nicely renovated and quiet. Big standard single room. Food surprisingly good and tasty. And excellent free coffee machine.
Cashier area has been renovated.

They've just rebranded to Phyathai Paholyothin Hospital (formerly Paolo Paholyothin Hospital). There are a lot going on here, renovations and constructions, so I think a just a year so many things will change from now.

Still a great service from all staff. The price is quits reasonable for this tier of private hospital in Thailand, however, much more affordable with health insurance. Their in-patient wards are decorated differently at each floor not wanting to be here anytime soon though but a really great looking place to be treated.

Recommended.... easy to travel either by car or public transport especially the BTS Saphan Kawai is just a minute walk away.

Some doctor anylyze the case and inform with high spped and then suddenly end conversation. He seem in a hurry.

Recently (Apr 1, 2024) changed from Paolo to Phayathai Hospital Phaholyothin.
Hopefully they will keep their good service as their standard.
Parking are available both on ground and on the car park building.

Private Hospital but each process of having the service is very slow and old fashioned. From register at reception, then wait for 10 minutes, then measure your blood pressure, then wait another 15-20 minutes. Seeing Doctor say only 5-10 minutes then wait another 30 minutes to receive your documents to go to another department to get your medicine and make the payment. Then go to the finance department wait another 30 minutes.  All of the above procedures happened at the time where there were only 1-2 patients!  Not sure how the management of this hospital is doing to set the precess is such a long time like in the public Hospital!

For me I had good experience the facial EMG is 9500 baths which is more like an European price but in Bangkok hospital they asked 30000 baths which is ridiculous scam price so I decided to come Phyathai and I was happy with the whole service/price.  I will be back.

Only problem I see is the cashier it take too long to pay.

Regards

I need to wait very long for the weight measurement and eye test after done the blood test and urine collection.

I have not received the medical report yet after 10 days of the checkup. Complaint email with details sent to you but no one responded.

Modern, professional and generally good service. The premises is clean and pleasantly decorated. They have English speaking attendants incase you cannot speak Thai. Price appears generally aligned with the other hospitals in Sukhumvit.
I been here from feb.17-march 04, 2021 for a required quarantine. Staff are great! Its clean. But its a bit pricey. If your a foreigner you have to really adjust because nurses doesnt speak english.

The Paolo Memorial Hospital appears to be a very good hospital with quality Thai doctors and nursing staff.  My experiences with them have been generally positive.  The hospital's administrative staff, however, could use some improvement. My wife and I were made to wait for 4 hours for our bill to be prepared before we could check out.

The staff make or break a hospital stay. The staff here at helpful, courteous, professional, and knowledgeable. For an international/private hospital, the English skill could have been better for the nurses (could have been worse). Overall it's a good place to be injured in.
If you've got the money, and want the care, the rooms are nice are can be worth it if you really want it.

Walked in for two packages in neurology center - carotid ultrasound and transcranial ultrasound. Total 8500 baht (discount because my wife is Thai).

After initial confusion at reception desk (be patient), all went well. Doctor performed the carotid scan himself and reviewed both tests with me afterwards.

Excellent care, nice staff, good hospital.

Poor queue management. I booked a package through HDMall and waited for my receipt on the 2nd floor for an hour. Turns out they completely forgot about my queue, if I hadn’t followed up, I might’ve been waiting there forever.

This hospital is so crowded and busy even on weekday.

I sought treatment at the dermatology clinic of this hospital. My dermatologist was attentive and spoke English well. She promptly and accurately diagnosed my problem. The plastic surgeon that I was referred to at this hospital was sensitive to my concerns and patiently addressed all of my questions. His surgical skills were very impressive. One nurse was tasked with changing my dressings post surgery and she was very attentive, capable and provided very useful information. The care I received here was superb. The two doctors that treated me and the nursing staff cared for me so I felt no stress. Great care! 😄
Not bad for seeing a doc and getting your meds, but for inpatient care it was a nightmare of poor communication.
Good staff. Old place but clean, Not easy to use a bathtub for old, sick, or disorder person.
Everyone was nice. Thank you 🙏🏻 …

Nice, efficient, super friendly and good hospital.
Access from front and backside with efficient parking.
Nearby shops, coffee shops and shopping.
Starbucks at the hospital.
Having an overall health check here. Staff is helpful and very good service. Also you can get some results from doctor in the same day.

Went for vaccinations. Upon arrival went to the International service centre. Was accompanied throughout the entire process - including payment - by a staff member who spoke English very well. All staff was extremely helpful and polite. I've also been to Phaya Thai 2 hospital with great experiences
Very professional staff an excellent services, I had the best hospital experience.

The parking space is too steep, making it difficult to drive. When I went for my annual visit, there was a very long queue at the station. The queue management was not good, and each patient ended up waiting far too long at their station.

At first it seems like a very good place, fast, efficient and somewhat attentive.
We got a 3in1 injections and saline treatments. Everything was great.

However, the doctor prescribed the heavy antibiotic too easily without any tests. Which then caused a bit of an unpleasant reaction and have to end the use of antibiotic prematurely.

Prevention: imo you should do research of the meds doctors prescribed first as well.

Analysis of your own body after treatments, wait and see if you need to take meds or no.

Ask them to do tests and get a diagnosis, this one we missed cos I was panicking and too trusting of the medical team.

Ps imo after reading most of the comments I think this hospital is trying way too hard to earn more than fixing patients problem… 🥲

I went for a walk-in health check-up at this hospital and had a great experience. The staff were friendly and helped guide me to each necessary clinic. They offered a variety of health check-up programs to choose from and accepted a wide range of health insurance providers. The doctors and nurses were also very welcoming.

The hospital staff was beyond my expectations. My personal experience it was perfect from the moment that i walked in to the moment that i left the hospital. The interpreter that i had was perfect, his english was better than mine :))
very accessible prices and treatment that i got and changed bandages it was very professional. The doctor it was very kind and helpful. Truly recommend it 100% it’s clean and carefully with every person.
This hospital has a fasfood (Blackcanyon coffee.You can take rest and read newspapers at around each department.

I visited here for my Medical Certificate.
They forgot about announcing my number
I had waited an extra hour without any word of apology...
I will not return here

Date: 26th of June
Department: Clinic to issue Medical Certificate
Check up closes at 3! what sort of Office hours are these?!

Personally I do not understand the bad reviews of tourists for this hospital - I came here because of a bad infection of my ear and was helped really well, the hospital is modern and the doctors seemed very qualified, better hospital than …

The nurses are ok, registration and vital check done quite fast in less 15min waiting time however the doctor not even examine anything and despite I told her I have blocked nose, she keep saying I have runny nose. I have flu, sore throat and cough sympthoms but the doctor not even check my throat until I asked her to do so and I also have to tell her to examine my lungs. This doesn't feel right and seems unprofessional.

I was at ARI lvl 8 clinic on 6th Aug around 10.30AM with Dr Napajaree

I visited a doctor here twice about an ongoing breathing problem. On the last visit, he prescribed some medicine for me. Unfortunately I lost the prescription, so I called the hospital to ask them to check to see what the name of the medicine was. They told me they do not keep any record of what medicine the doctor prescribes, and the only way the could find the information would be if I had purchased the medicine from their pharmacy.  Seriously?  What kind of low-class, third-world hospital does not keep track of what medicine a doctor prescribes for a patient for an ongoing problem?  This hospital is NOT cheap.  I am now wondering if they are telling the truth, or just trying to punish me for not buying the medicine from their overpriced pharmacy, but it is clear that this is NOT a professional hospital and healthcare is NOT their primary concern.

I was a bit apprehended to have any dental work done in Bangkok for years. But a friend recommended me to Paolo Hospital and it was seamless and all the staffs were so polite. The Dentist speaks good English and explains the course of my treatment very well. Overall a good experience and a fair price.
Fast and excellent service from all staff. Clean.

Was given the option to do another test so I took it just to be sure. When I went to pay for my medication, I was told that test cost 3,000 baht. I probably should've asked if it cost more, but I also would've expected one of the doctors or nurses to tell me about the price beforehand. I never would've done the extra test if I was told about the price.

- Security guard at parking building is nice with service mind.
- Staff in Health Check-up Department on 13th floor look busy and moody all the time.  It is a place that customers seem polite than staff.  Their sound is …

Please educate and give the training all staff who mamage queue about First In First Out concept. When calling for the queue from the document tray, please start from the first document at the bottom first not the last on the top of the tray. So poor management. If you can choose other hospital, please.. don't choose this. I have to choose due to company restriction.

Great services at good price comparing with the private hospitals in the same group (BDMS).
I came here for vaccination, no booking, and got unexpected attentions and care from the staffs. Last time, I went to another hospital which is more costly and had faced some unpleasant welcoming experiences.

Came here for a check-up to renew my work permit, it took excessively long. In other hospitals or clinics, it doesn't take more than an hour, but here it took 3 over hours. Nurses and doctors are nice but the waiting time is just way too long.

The hospital is old and is a private hospital but provides services like a government hospital.  Been working very slowly ever since.  11:00 I don't know what to wait until almost 1 p.m., good welcome, good advice, good service, but long.

They have the worst service for health check up. I went here for a health check up and the whole process took more than 4 hours. Their operation was so not efficient. Despite making appointment in advance we still need to wait for a long …

Service was really fast, the doctors are very professional and so efficient. The hospital is nice and clean and organised. The few times I've visited for Out-patient check ups has been a really good experience.

Went here after a dog bite because it was recommended from the hostel as it was across the street. Was seem within 20 minutes of arrival. I found it a bit disturbing that I had to insist on getting my post exposure rabies shots (I had the 3 pre-exposure doses), the doctor was going to send me away with just antibiotics, saying my 3 shots were enough and if the dog had rabies it would be dead already (if that was the case, why bother with rabies vaccines anyway?). Generally it seemed like there was more focus on making my visit comfortable than actually giving me the treatment I needed. The nurse was very careful when cleaning and dressing the wound, and administering the vaccine. I think that one of the wounds could have used some stitches too, now I'll have a nasty scar on my leg that probably could have been prevented.

For my second post exposure shot I was sent to the ER, probably because I came early in the morning so that I could catch my 9am bus. There I felt like the care was much more on point, they knew what was up. Probably would have been better off if I would up there for my first visit.

English Speakers: Don’t go to this hospital. Our pregnancy doctor, Kannika Chokram, is extremely rude. Dr. Kannika’s English proficiency seems quite low and/or is rude because she will not answer questions when asked directly in English. …

It was difficult to reach call center. They kept me waiting for a long time. Unprofessional cooperation. It took them more than a month to send a health checkup report and they couldn’t reply what the cause of delay was.
Ear, nose and throat clinic open during 9am -7pm
Good hospital. Clean, professional and relatively effective.

I had staph infection and went to see the doctor about it and to get a medical note to say I wasn’t able to fight for a muay Thai match. He was however reluctant to provide a note and suggested the antibiotics will have mild effect on me. These antibiotics were very strong, and I was prescribed two. I was left with small
Assurance that this doctor was aware of the potentional effects on the medication  on different individuals, next time I will try a different dermatologist

Overpriced compared to Vimut hospital. My bf went to Vimut hospital and got the same treatment (injection and medication) and paid only half I paid. I feel ripped off, I asked to see the list and one cotton ball costs 20 baht and so on.
Scheduling an MRI for an accident, only to have another accident happen later, can void insurance coverage and fail to protect the patient's rights.

Please improve your workflow. I've been waiting for my test results for a very long time. The staff said it would take an hour, but it's been 3 hours and I still haven't received them. If you're going to say "wait an hour," don't say it at all; it's much longer than that.

On June 15th, 2026, I went for a pre-employment health check. The check included weighing, eyesight, blood pressure, and a chest X-ray.
The wait was extremely long, especially for the X-ray results. When I asked the nurse, she just told me to wait. This wasn't a urine or blood test, and it still took that long! Luckily, a staff member who took my blood pressure came over and asked if I had the results yet, probably because they recognized me. I told them I hadn't received them yet and asked if they could check on the results. That staff member then took my card to check the results, and that's how I got them. If I hadn't asked, I wouldn't have gotten them. I just kept waiting. This is a private clinic, not a government one.

The treatment was the same, but the price was different each time. There was no price notification before treatment. The service was inconsistent; sometimes good, sometimes bad. Nurses should speak more politely, especially since it's a private clinic and people are paying them. My last visit was very disappointing.

text: The medical staff at Phyathai 2 Hospital are of lower standard. Some doctors and nurses—and I emphasize *some*—lack psychology and effective communication skills. For minor illnesses, this might be overlooked, but if you suspect a serious condition, I personally recommend traveling a little further to Phyathai 2 Hospital; it's more reliable.

Honestly, their prices are reasonable compared to other hospitals. The examination itself is generally good, but once you finish and pay, the service changes drastically. I was particularly dissatisfied with their behavior, even delaying car requests and other things.

text: The doctors and nurses are lovely; the service is good.

I'm leaving a review here because the doctors here are skilled and kind.
The nurses take very good care of you. The doctors here give good advice and are very kind.

Did you know? We now have Elite rooms for your health check-ups – no crowds, it's convenient and wonderful! And if you're an AIA Prestige member, you can choose two free gifts when you get your check-up during your birthday month. Excellent!

I usually use this hospital regularly, and I was surprised to see so many negative reviews in the past two or three months. Now that I've experienced it myself, I understand.

The hospital's service is currently very self-serving. If you're sick and recovering in the ward, they'll move you upstairs for a day, then move you back down. It's a clear case of the hospital prioritizing its own needs. Staff can't do or say anything because it's hospital policy. I think management should listen to both the patients and the lower-level staff.

If it's not a serious case, moving up and down is okay, it just wastes time. But for serious cases, they need to reconsider their approach.

Personally, I think the doctors and nurses are still as dedicated to providing good service as before.

text: This nurse's attitude was... indescribable.

The wait was extremely long, both with the doctor and the finance department. (I arrived before my scheduled appointment, even past it, and finally they told me the doctor I was scheduled to see was in a meeting and I had to change doctors. The finance department also took a very long time.)

The wait times are extremely long every time, except for dentistry. The nurses look like they don't want to serve you; if you don't go and ask them, they'll just sit around chatting. The finance department also takes longer than a government hospital. At this price, you'd probably be better off going somewhere else.

I paid for treatment here, hoping for good and accurate care. I visited the doctor here twice, and each time the doctor examined me hastily. I was told I had dizziness and nausea, and the doctor prescribed medication for the symptoms. In the end, I had to go to another hospital because I was diagnosed with gastritis. Please pay more attention to patient care.

This time, my partner was unwell and needed treatment at
Phyathai Phaholyothin Hospital.
He needed to be admitted, so we booked a room in advance. We got a Deluxe room …

We met with the translators Ali and Hanafi, who were very polite and helpful. We enjoyed their company and they were very helpful to us, along with the doctor. Sister Rungrat also helped us download the software and was very welcoming and kind. We also met the doctor, who was very respectful and had excellent manners; he even knew some Arabic.

We thank the staff who welcomed us.

The medical care here might be fine, but the payment system is an absolute nightmare. I had to wait over an hour just to pay my bill. The process is incredibly slow, inefficient, and highly frustrating. When people are at a hospital, they are already exhausted or unwell—forcing them to sit around just to hand over their money is unacceptable. Management needs to upgrade their payment system and improve this process immediately.
Nurse Khwanjai is very lovely and provides excellent service. She followed up on my case, which had caused a long wait from another nurse.

I had a doctor's appointment. I arrived at the hospital at 10:15 AM, had blood drawn, and waited for the results for an hour. Then I went to eat. I came back and waited until after 11 AM. I waited until all the other patients had seen the doctor, but they didn't call me. People who came after me went first. The nurse only gave out queue numbers at 1:30 PM. They must have just seen me. I was angry. I had already handed over my appointment slip. Didn't they check if they missed anyone? The whole process, from payment to leaving the hospital, took until after 2 PM. I took a half-day off work, which ended up being a full day. I'm very dissatisfied. I'll give more stars if the service is better next time.

(Gastroenterology Clinic)
P.S. The nurse apologized, but I'm still angry.

This private hospital provides service as slow as a public hospital. I waited for half an hour to sign the insurance claim form and still haven't been able to, even though the service fee is several times higher than normal (eight thousand five hundred baht for two wisdom tooth extractions).

A modern private hospital offering comprehensive medical services with high quality and state-of-the-art equipment. The medical staff is professional, and the service is relatively fast compared to other hospitals. It's suitable for …
The service was excellent. The staff were polite and courteous.
The service was excellent!
Good service, reasonable price.

My younger brother had an accident and came here to get his wounds treated. The doctor did a great job, gave good advice, and examined him thoroughly, paying attention to every detail. It was fast, convenient, and clean. We came during Chinese New Year and even got a red envelope from the hospital.
good

The service was excellent.
